scripts.check: node scripts/workspace.ts check && node scripts/installers.ts --check && pnpm --filter @tool-logger/transport check && pnpm --filter @tool-logger/protocol check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.test: node --test tests/*.test.ts && pnpm --filter @tool-logger/transport test && pnpm --filter @tool-logger/web check && pnpm --filter @tool-logger/desktop check
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @tool-logger/web build && go build -o build/tool-logger ./apps/cli && pnpm --filter @tool-logger/desktop build
scripts.test:distribution: node scripts/installers.ts --check && node --test tests/distribution.test.ts tests/workspace.test.ts tests/opencode-workspace.test.ts
